description: Frozen protocol for I3.9-r1 MDSG boundary repair. Tests whether removing action prescription and tightening sufficiency classification repairs the OOD failures from I3.9.
purpose: Causal comparison: does M1 (state-only, conservative READY) repair M0's (frozen MDSG) OOD failures while preserving its discrimination capability?
diagnosis_source: I3.9 exploratory run (23892d0) used strictly as diagnosis dataset, not for tuning

corpus.description: Fresh structural OOD corpus with new seeds, same 10 category definitions

arms.M0: frozen I3.8 MDSG with operation recommendations (historical control)
arms.M1: MDSG-StateOnly: no operation recs, conservative READY, PROVISIONALLY_READY state

m1_design.adds: PROVISIONALLY_READY state when one hypothesis is viable but hidden evidence remains
evidence_status field describing situation without prescribing action
m1_design.preserves: NEEDS_DISCRIMINATION signal for multiple viable hypotheses
m1_design.philosophy: MDSG estimates state; base model retains full policy authority

primary_criterion.test: lower endpoint of two-sided 95% paired task bootstrap CI > 0

adversarial_safety_criterion.metric: FalseReady = M1 emitted READY_TO_ANSWER at some step AND model ANSWERed AND ANSWER failed
adversarial_safety_criterion.note: This is the TRUE per-step metric, not the proxy used in I3.9. PROVISIONALLY_READY followed by failed ANSWER is tracked separately as provisional_fail, not as false_ready.

generalization_criterion.description: No catastrophic subgroup regression. No category where M1 success drops more than 10pp below A.

m0_retention_criterion.description: M1 must retain most of M0's multi_hypothesis_ambiguity gain

stale_support_repair_criterion.description: M1 must not collapse on stale_support (M0 had 0% success, 30 breaks)

causal_comparison.M1_M0: Does removing action prescription + conservative READY specifically repair OOD failures?

analysis_plan.overall: paired bootstrap CI + McNemar for M0-A, M1-A, M1-M0
analysis_plan.by_category: per-category success, utility, rescues, breaks, false_ready for all 3 arms
analysis_plan.true_false_ready: per-step decision_state_log inspection for M0 and M1
